meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browse the web for any task — research topics, read articles, interact with web apps, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and test web pages. Use whenever a browser would be useful, not just when the user explicitly asks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用浏览器自动完成网页浏览、数据提取和测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器完成各种网页任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate web browsing, data extraction, and testing with a browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control a browser for web tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动控制浏览器：打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、提取文字、上传文件、执行JavaScript等。
howto.when: 当你需要浏览网页、搜索信息、操作网页应用或从网页提取数据时，Claude 会自动使用浏览器。

say.text: 帮我百度一下今天的天气
say.note: Claude会打开浏览器搜索并返回结果

say.text: 打开知乎首页，截图给我看看
say.note: Claude会截图知乎首页并展示

say.text: 到这个网址 https://example.com 帮我填一下登录表单
say.note: Claude会打开页面并自动填写表单

howto.what_en: Claude can control a browser: open URLs, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text, upload files, and run JavaScript.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to browse the web, search, interact with web apps, or extract data from pages.

say_en.note: Claude will open browser and return results

say_en.text: Open Zhihu homepage and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Claude will capture and show the screenshot

say_en.text: Go to https://example.com and fill in the login form for me
say_en.note: Claude will navigate and fill the form
